symbols.name: ground set size
symbols.meaning: The number of elements of the ground set; it counts the elements, not the subsets.
symbols.quote: Let $\Upsilon$ be the number of elements of the ground set, a positive integer.

symbols.name: three-element subsets
symbols.meaning: The set of all subsets of the ground set that have exactly three elements.
symbols.quote: Write $\mathcal{T}$ for the set of three-element subsets of $[\Upsilon]$.

relations.quote: Concretely, a ground set indexes the data banks of a [Linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md) through its three-element subsets.
